description: Issue a fresh verification token for a customer whose status is pending and hand it to the workspace's app as the webhook event account.verification_requested - cmssy never emails a customer, the app does. The previous token stops working and the new one lasts 24 hours. Refused for a customer who is already verified or is suspended, and after five account requests for the same customer in an hour. `endpointSubscribed: false` means the token was issued but no enabled webhook endpoint receives the event, so nothing reaches the customer.
name: resend_customer_verification
title: Resend customer verification
